values.note: '110+ RV Sites': back-in regular sites (32-55 ft), pull-throughs (mostly 60 ft, one 80) and waterfront sites (30-75 ft) on RoverPass. RVs 15 years or older need management's approval from photos sent before booking.

sites.source: https://www.lakesrv.com/ ('110+ RV Sites', 'Wide pull-throughs') + RoverPass sitesAvailableDuring for each RV rate on 2026-11-10 (maxLength 30-80 ft) + RoverPass rules ('Any RV 15 years or older, must be approved and have an uploaded photo to be approved by management'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.lakesrv.com/amenities ('High-Speed WiFi', 'Showers & Restrooms', 'Laundry Facility: On-site washers and dryers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Online booking sells single nights April-December, but every RV rate from January through March requires 90 nights (RoverPass 'minNightsRequired' 90 on 2027-01-26, 01-30, 02-09 and 03-09) although the rate sheet posts winter daily prices; call 239-229-5436 for shorter winter stays. Bookable up to 12 months ahead. No refunds on cancellation (deposits can be applied to a future stay). Check-in 1-10 pm. EV charging $20 a night.

booking.source: RoverPass booking API for lakes-park-rv-fort-myers-fl (advancedMonths 12; minNightsRequired 1 on 2026-11-10, 2026-12-08, 2027-04-13, 2027-06-08; 90 on 2027-01-26, 2027-01-30, 2027-02-09, 2027-03-09; cancellation policy 'No refunds upon cancellations'; rule 'Any charging of electric vehicles will be $20 nightly') + https://www.lakesrv.com/ ('Ready to book? note: RV park on US-41 (S Tamiami Trl) beside Lakes Regional Park, Fort Myers, on a lake; the operator calls itself an extended-stay community (travel nurses, trades, snowbirds) and also sells monthly and annual sites. --Claude
summary: Operator's site + its RoverPass booking engine: confirmed $65-120 nightly and 30/50-amp. Added full hookups (water/sewer), 80-ft max with pull-throughs, showers/laundry/Wi-Fi, RoverPass booking 12 months out, and a 90-night online minimum for January-March arrivals. Note cleaned of the rate table the fees carry.
flags: Long-stay tests: online, every RV rate for January-March arrivals needs 90 nights (RoverPass minNightsRequired 90 on four winter dates), though lakesrv.com/rates posts winter daily prices; single nights are sold online only April-December. The operator calls the park 'one of Fort Myers' premier extended-stay RV communities' and sells annual sites. Recorded the winter minimum in booking.min_stay; AWH may want to judge whether winter counts as nights for sale.
Name: RoverPass's slug and RV Life list it as 'Lakes Park RV'; the operator's own name is 'Lakes RV' (matches the entry).
